app.name: JunkSnap
app.tagline: Snap the junk. Prove it. Get it cleared.

common.comingSoon: This screen will be built soon.

auth.codeSent: A new code has been sent.
auth.verified: Email verified. You can log in now.

about.title: How JunkSnap works
about.intro: Snap a photo of waste, 10 people confirm it, and we draft a letter for the right authority.
about.cityText: How quickly the city clears waste and services bins.
about.citizenText: How much waste people are dumping.
about.binText: Whether people have a legal place to dump waste at all.

areas.binHint: Fewer areas without any bin is better

nobin.title: No dustbin near me
nobin.intro: Stand where you are. If there is no dustbin within {{km}} km of you, report it. Reports within 500 m of each other form one community zone, and {{total}} people make it verified.
nobin.confirm: I am standing here, and there is no dustbin within about {{km}} km of me.
nobin.privacy: We save only an approximate point (about 100 m) for the zone, never your exact location or your name.
nobin.problemPoorGps: GPS is too weak (needs ±{{max}} m or better). Move to an open area and wait.
nobin.newText: {{count}} of {{total}} people have said they have no dustbin here. Ask neighbours who also have no dustbin nearby to report from where they are.
nobin.joinedText: {{count}} of {{total}} people near you have now said there is no dustbin nearby.
nobin.verifiedText: {{total}} people have now confirmed this zone. Thank you!
nobin.peopleSay: {{count}} of {{total}} people say they have no dustbin nearby
nobin.alsoNoBin: I also have no dustbin nearby
nobin.approxNote: The circle is approximate (its centre is rounded to about 100 m).

bin.none: No dustbin is mapped on OpenStreetMap within 1 km of this zone.
bin.osmNote: OpenStreetMap can be incomplete, so this is only a hint. It does not decide verification.
